units.source_text: 左右见此情景，都把自己的性命置之不顾，而同情源氏公子的不幸。

en.t: When those around him saw this scene, they thought nothing of their own lives and grieved over Prince Genji's misfortune.

units.source_text: 像他这样身份高贵的人物，而身逢古无前例的灾厄，他们觉得非常可悲。

en.t: They found it deeply pitiful that someone of such noble rank should meet with a disaster without precedent.

units.source_text: 凡是能振奋精神而稍稍恢复元气的人，都真心感动，愿舍自身性命，以救公子一人。

en.t: Everyone who could rouse himself and recover even a little strength was moved from the heart, wishing to give up his own life to save the prince alone.

units.source_text: 他们齐声向神佛祈祷：“谨告十方神灵：

en.t: Together they prayed to the gods and Buddhas, saying, "We humbly address the divine spirits of all directions:

units.source_text: 我公子生长深宫，自幼惯享游乐，而秉性仁慈，德泽普及万民；

en.t: Our prince was born and raised deep within the palace, accustomed from childhood to pleasure and refinement, yet by nature he is compassionate, and his virtue has reached all the people;

units.source_text: 扶穷救弱，拯灾济危，善举不可胜数。

en.t: He has supported the poor, rescued the weak, saved those in disaster, and aided those in danger; his good deeds are beyond counting.

units.source_text: 但不知前生有何罪孽，今将溺死于此险恶之风波中？

en.t: Yet what sin from a former life could cause him now to drown amid these perilous winds and waves?

units.source_text: 仰求天地神佛，判断是非曲直。

en.t: We look up and beseech the gods and Buddhas of heaven and earth to judge right and wrong, justice and injustice.

units.source_text: 无辜而获罪，剥夺官爵，背井离乡，朝夕不安，日夜愁叹。

en.t: Though innocent, he was condemned, stripped of office and rank, forced to leave his home, uneasy morning and evening, lamenting day and night.

units.source_text: 今又遭此可悲之天变，性命垂危。

en.t: Now he has again met with this sorrowful calamity of nature, and his life hangs in the balance.

units.source_text: 不知此乃前生之孽报，抑或今世之罪罚？

en.t: We do not know whether this is retribution for sin in a former life, or punishment for guilt in this present world.

units.source_text: 倘蒙神佛明鉴，务请消灾降福！”

en.t: If the gods and Buddhas will see clearly into the matter, we beg you to dispel this disaster and bestow blessing!"

units.source_text: 他们向着住吉明神神社方向，立下种种誓愿。

en.t: Facing in the direction of the shrine of Sumiyoshi Myojin, they made all manner of vows.

units.source_text: 源氏公子也向海龙王及诸神佛许愿。

en.t: Prince Genji too made vows to the Dragon King of the Sea and to all the gods and Buddhas.
